title: Rhynie chert: an early land ecosystem
summary: Near Rhynie in Aberdeenshire, Scotland, an Early Devonian ecosystem of hot springs and geysers in a river valley was preserved in silica about 400 million years ago. The chert, whose significance was recognised in 1912, holds early land plants such as Horneophyton, fungi, bacteria and arthropods, including the trigonotarbid Palaeocharinus.

uncertainty.note: NatureScot gives about 400 million years; one news report gives 407 million.
